html:
When registering for an Open Platform account, please first determine the intended use of your system: whether it is for your own internal store only, or whether it will be sold to Lazada sellers as SaaS software or any other third-party service.

Register for an account

Registration Link

Enter your account information

Note:

-- Your registration email is also your login email and cannot be changed on your own. If you need to change it, please create a support ticket to contact us;

-- The “Full Name” field cannot contain “lazada”;

-- Your password cannot contain “!”, “<”, or “>”.

Verify Your Email Address

After entering your email address, full name, and password, click the “Next” button and slide the slider to the right.

You will receive an email from the Lazada Open Platform in your inbox. Please enter the verification code from the email into the verification code field and click “Sign up” to complete your account registration.

Complete the Basic Information

After completing the account registration, you will also need to fill out your account information and submit it for review.

page link

Country

Please select the country where your company or office is located.

Partner type

Enterprises Commercial

If your application or service is sold as a third-party service—such as SaaS software—for use by sellers on the Lazada platform, please select this category;

Enterprise/Personal Self-Developed

If your app or service is intended solely for use by you or your group’s internal Lazada stores, please select this type.

Business Information

Please enter your company’s information as it appears in your company registration documents in the “Legal Business Name,” “Business Registration Number,” and “Name of Business Owner” fields.

Also, upload a copy of your business registration document—which must include the “Business Registration Number”—in the “Upload copy of business registration file” section. Please ensure that the information in the registration document matches the company details you entered.

Finally, enter your company or office address in the “City/Town,” “Specific Address,” and “Postal Code” fields.

Contact Information

Enterprises Commercial

Users who select this option should ensure that the mobile number and email address they enter in the “Mobile number” and “Email” fields have not been used to register a store on Lazada; otherwise, they may encounter an account conflict error when registering for the “Service Provider” role later on.

Enterprise/Personal Self-Developed

Please enter your contact information in the “Mobile number” and “Email” fields and verify it; there are no specific requirements for these fields.

Note：If you do not receive the OTP, try adding a “0” at the beginning of your phone number.

Submit

Once you have entered and verified all the information, click “Completed” to submit. We will review your submission within 3 business days. If the review is not complete after 3 business days, please submit a support ticket to contact us.
